title: Reclaiming Low-Quality Instruction Data with Rule-Guided LLM Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2510.23160v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Data selection for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) often discards low-scoring instruction examples that may retain useful supervision. We propose a rule-guided LLM reconstruction framework to reclaim this information. The framework identifies low-scoring samples through LLM-based rating and score correction, selects semantically representative sources, and reconstructs instruction-response pairs through strategy-guided generation, criteria-based validation, and failure-guided repair. From 123,786 low-scoring samples, it constructs 54,888 training examples. Across three 7B/8B base LLMs, the reconstructed data achieves higher average downstream performance than the low-scoring source set and all evaluated data-selection baselines. Despite using substantially fewer examples than the full source dataset (approximately 300K), it achieves higher reported average scores than full-data training across all three base models. translated_title: 利用规则引导的大语言模型重构回收低质量指令数据
translated_abstract: 针对监督微调（SFT）的数据选择方法通常会丢弃低分的指令样本，而这些样本可能仍然保留有用的监督信息。我们提出了一种规则引导的大语言模型（LLM）重构框架来回收这些信息。该框架通过基于LLM的评分和分数修正来识别低分样本，选取语义上具有代表性的源数据，并通过策略引导的生成、基于标准的验证以及失败引导的修复来重构指令-回复对。该框架从123,786个低分样本中构建了54,888个训练样本。在三个7B/8B基座大语言模型上，重构数据取得了比低分源数据集以及所有被评估的数据选择基线更高的平均下游性能。尽管使用的样本数量远少于完整源数据集（约30万条），它在所有三个基座模型上都取得了比全量数据训练更高的报告平均分数。逐步消融实验……
tldr: 提出一种规则引导的LLM重构框架，将SFT数据选择中通常被丢弃的低分指令样本转化为高质量训练数据，在三个7B/8B模型上以远少于全量数据的样本数（约5.5万条）超越了全量训练和数据选择基线的性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes a rule-guided LLM reconstruction framework that reclaims low-scoring instruction samples typically discarded during SFT data selection, converting 123,786 samples into 54,888 high-quality training examples that outperform both data-selection baselines and full-data training across three 7B/8B base LLMs.
